config.name: Pre-scoring locked northern ECS observation-source verification
config.scope: Designed after all earlier source-region and destination OISST results were known. Satellite and buoy files already cover the destination and were acquired during earlier stages; no prior destination instrument scores were produced. This locks forecast arrays, source versions and scoring rules publicly before scoring this subset, not before data acquisition. It is a conditional geographical instrument extension, not a blind holdout, live prospective forecast, full-basin or independent-latent-truth validation. Primary inference retains 2 anomaly models x 3 leads x 3 fixed simple baselines on 2023-2025 nighttime AMSR2, Holm-adjusted as 18 comparisons separately for 30/60-day blocks. Inadequate coverage suppresses inference without changing thresholds. All other models, matched OISST, afternoon, partial 2026 and buoy comparisons are descriptive. No tuning, calibration or outcome-based exclusion.
